text: 我有个问题。
en: I have a question.

text: 你们为什么默认是女人卖给男人？
en: Why do you assume by default that it is women selling to men?

text: 为啥不能是女卖女，男卖男，男卖女？
en: Why can't it be women selling to women, men selling to men, men selling to women?

text: 再进一步讲，买卖双方凭啥不能是非二元性别的少数群体？
en: Going further, why can't the buyer and the seller be non-binary gender minorities?

text: 你们太不进步了。
en: You are not progressive enough.

text: 一个很搞笑的事实是，当前鼓吹卖淫合法的人，恰恰没有意识到，我国从管仲开始搞的性资源管理政策体系，2000年以来一直是换汤不换药的——他们所谓的卖淫合法事实上早就融入我国的社会生活了，只不过是以另一种性专营的模式，并且通过两类渠道分别被教育和公安两个部门或多或少地管理着。
en: A rather amusing fact is that those who currently advocate for the legalisation of prostitution have precisely failed to realise that our country's system of sexual resource management policy, which has been in place since Zhong Guan, has for two thousand years been changing the soup but not the medicine — what they call the legalisation of prostitution has in fact long been woven into our country's social life, merely in another model of sexual monopoly, and is managed to varying degrees by the two departments of education and public security through two channels.

text: 在当前这个性压抑的社会环境下，我不想反驳支持卖淫合法的人。
en: In the current sexually repressive social environment, I do not wish to argue against those who support the legalisation of prostitution.

text: 卖淫如果合法化，市场竞争会激烈。
en: If prostitution were legalised, market competition would grow fierce.

text: 单次卖淫价格会快速降低，男性结婚欲望也会降低。
en: The price of a single act of prostitution would fall rapidly, and men's desire to marry would also diminish.

text: 卖淫一直是合法的啊，你见过哪个二奶金丝雀被判刑了么？
en: Prostitution has always been legal — have you ever seen any kept mistress or 'golden canary' sentenced?

text: 没有吧。
en: No, I don't think there are.

text: 那被包养算不算卖淫？
en: Then does being kept count as prostitution?

text: 包养了也不是拿来看的对吧。
en: But being kept isn't merely for show, is it?

text: 所以卖淫不合法么？
en: So is prostitution not legal, then?

text: 在批发合法的大环境下，基于自由意志的零售也应当合法，不管是男性还是女性。
en: In an environment where wholesale is legal, retail based on free will ought also to be legal, be it for men or for women.

text: 只要当中不存在胁迫暴力监禁剥削，我若是性工作者也要问个为什么凭什么？
en: So long as there is no coercion, violence, detention or exploitation involved, were I a sex worker I too would ask why and on what grounds?

text: 为什么她们被包养一月10w就合法？
en: Why is it legal for them to be kept for 100,000 a month?

text: 凭什么我自愿一晚上2k就违法？
en: On what grounds is my voluntary act of 2,000 a night illegal?

text: 凭什么？
en: On what grounds?

text: 就凭她有渠道有机会批发？
en: Merely because she has the connections and the chance to operate wholesale?

text: 等到有一天，二奶入刑，包养费用全额追回，那个时候再来探讨卖淫是否合法也不迟。
en: When the day comes that kept mistresses are criminalised and the cost of being kept is recovered in full, then it will not be too late to discuss whether prostitution is legal.

text: 就目前来说，我支持所有基于个人自由意志的安全保守的出卖性服务，从几w一次的高端伴游到公园10块一次的老头乐，我都无条件的支持。
en: For now, I support all safe, conservative sexual services sold on the basis of individual free will, from high-end escort companionship at tens of thousands per session down to the 'old man's joy' in the park at ten yuan a time — I support them all unconditionally.

text: 最后重申一下，我反对一切胁迫暴力剥削社交限制行为。
en: To reiterate at the end, I oppose all acts of coercion, violence, exploitation and social restriction.

text: 卖淫合法的前提就是官办计院，也就是所谓的公娼。
en: The precondition for legalising prostitution is state-run brothels, that is, the so-called public brothels.

text: 所以如果你养了个漂亮闺女，你猜会不会有人处心积虑把她弄进去。
en: So if you have raised a pretty daughter, can you guess whether someone will deliberately scheme to get her in there.

text: 我不光反对卖淫
en: I do not merely oppose prostitution

text: 我还想给每个人戴上监测项圈
en: I also want to put a monitoring collar on everyone

text: 记录每个人的身体状况
en: to record everyone's physical condition

text: 每天劳动时间
en: their daily working hours

text: 每天劳动强度
en: their daily labour intensity

text: 跟谁发生过性关系
en: with whom they have had sexual relations

text: 每天吃过什么
en: what they have eaten each day

text: 以及每个人的资产、消费以及资金流水记录
en: as well as each person's assets, consumption and financial transaction records

text: 记录将会根据不同关系级别延迟查询
en: The records will be subject to deferred access enquiries according to different levels of relationship

text: 比如父母、伴侣都能够实时查阅得到
en: for instance, parents and partners would both be able to consult them in real time

text: 官员直接强制公开每个人都能查到1-3个月前的信息
en: officials are made directly and compulsorily public, and everyone can look up information from one to three months prior

text: 实现社会主义需要严格监督每一个人去工作
en: To realise socialism requires strictly supervising every individual to work

text: 不允许不劳而获以及以权谋私
en: It does not permit getting something for nothing or abusing power for personal gain

text: 没必要反驳，远离就行。
en: There is no need to rebut; simply keep your distance.

text: 支持性交易产业合法化的群体，大概率是单身中产和底层男性，自信自己不会处于人身权利被剥夺的弱势方，希望通过剥夺他人（主要是女性）的人身权利以获取利益，他们只能看到性交易产业合法化会方便他们自己获取性资源。
en: The groups that support the legalisation of the sex trade industry are, in all likelihood, single middle-class and underclass men, who are confident they will not find themselves in the disadvantaged position of having their personal rights stripped away, and who hope to gain benefit by depriving others (mainly women) of their personal rights; they can only see that legalising the sex trade industry would make it convenient for them to obtain sexual resources.

text: 他们现在是强势方，仅仅是因为还有更弱势的女性为他们垫底。
en: They are in a position of strength now only because there are even more disadvantaged women holding the bottom for them.

text: 但他们不会意识到，当女性完全成为非人的资源，那么他们会成为被视为“完全人”的男性中的底层弱势方，会成为“女性”。
en: But they will not realise that when women become completely dehumanised resources, then they will become the underclass and disadvantaged among men regarded as 'fully human', and will become 'women'.

text: 他们以为自己会是纯粹的消费端，但更大的可能是，他们会成为销售端，将自己身边的女性资源（妻女姐妹母亲）贩卖出去，等到卖无可卖时，他们就只能像他们所鄙夷的女性一样销售自己。
en: They think they would be purely the consuming end, but the greater possibility is that they would become the selling end, peddling the female resources around them (wives, daughters, sisters, mothers); when there is nothing left to sell, they can only sell themselves just like the women they despise.

text: 他们对权力和现实的认知，就像生活在球形鱼缸里的金鱼一样单纯而短视。
en: Their understanding of power and reality is as innocent and short-sighted as goldfish living in a spherical fishbowl.

text: 卖淫合法有点类似于允许军队滥杀敌国平民。
en: Legalising prostitution is somewhat akin to allowing the military to wantonly slaughter civilians of enemy states.

text: 本身未必会对自身造成多大伤害，但这是一个总崩溃的开始，需要防微杜渐。
en: In itself it may not cause much harm to oneself, but it is the beginning of a total collapse, and one must guard against it at the first sign.

text: 合法不合法，这个行业都一直存在
en: Legal or not, this industry has always existed

text: 无非是你想不想让从业者拥有合法权益而已
en: it is merely a question of whether you want those in the trade to possess lawful rights and interests

text: 我对组织卖淫合法化的顾虑是，组织卖淫是一个行业，行业利润就是既要让直接提供劳动的人赚钱，又要让提供周边服务的配套赚钱，那是不是，会有很大概率通过污名化和其他方式，提高自愿性行为，也就是反而会禁止或者嘲笑性生活的免费互助。
en: My concern about legalising organised prostitution is this: organised prostitution is an industry, and an industry's profit means both that those who directly provide the labour must earn money and that the supporting services providing peripheral services must also earn money — so is it not highly probable that, through stigmatisation and other means, voluntary sexual behaviour would be promoted, that is, it would instead forbid or ridicule the free mutual aid of sexual life?

text: 因为组织卖淫要能全员赚钱，特别是让不参与直接劳动的人抽到头，他们必须是要减少竞争对手的。
en: Because organised prostitution must enable everyone to make money, especially letting those who do not take part in direct labour take a cut, they must necessarily reduce their competitors.

text: 人家旗下的姑娘小伙收万儿八千睡，有些姑娘小伙喜欢就睡一起，那怎么可以？
en: The girls and boys under their banner charge eight or ten thousand to sleep with someone, while some girls and boys just sleep together because they like each other — how could that be allowed?

text: 那么必定以行业标准和营销手段丑化喜欢也能发生性行为啊，没准就是年轻人不该老是和爱人做爱，这是互相的加重负担，真正的尊重和喜欢是分房睡，
en: Then they will surely use industry standards and marketing tactics to disparage the idea that those who like each other can also have sex — maybe it will be said that young people ought not keep having sex with their lovers, for that is a mutual added burden, and that true respect and affection mean sleeping in separate rooms,

text: 喜欢了就只睡一个人，不做兼职是对生活和感情的不认真不负责，等等等等，就像现在做家务做饭一样，哪怕你喜欢做家务做饭，社会评价就是除非你能证明自己完全财务自由，
en: that liking someone means sleeping with only one person, and not taking a side job is being unserious and irresponsible towards life and feelings, and so on and so forth, just like doing housework and cooking nowadays — even if you like doing housework and cooking, society's verdict is that unless you can prove you are completely financially free,

text: 否则就是你穷你还不够努力，一个年轻人怎么可以喜欢做家务，有力气应该去加班，没力气你就是应该去点外卖刷手机啊，没有财务自由就通过做家务做饭来修复自己是蹉跎岁月，
en: otherwise it just means you are poor and have not worked hard enough; how can a young person like doing housework? If you have energy you should work overtime; if you have no energy you should just order takeaway and scroll on your phone. To restore yourself through housework and cooking without financial freedom is to waste your years;

text: 是不懂非核心事务外包。
en: it shows you do not understand outsourcing non-core tasks.

text: 家务做饭会变成一个人生活可外包的非核心事务，做爱是不是也会变成两个人交往的非核心事物呢？
en: Will housework and cooking become outsourced non-core tasks in a person's life, and will having sex also become a non-core matter in a couple's relationship?

text: 当然了也许等到行业完全竞争科技进步，工业化智能化大大降低成本，大家都赚个辛苦钱了这事也没了，比如现在可以大大利用工具的定时烤箱，空气炸锅，电饭煲高压锅，洗衣机，扫地机器人什么的，又可以让我们普通人哪怕没有财务自由，也可以大方宣扬在家自己干又轻松又快乐。
en: Of course, perhaps when the industry becomes fully competitive and technology advances, with industrialisation and intelligent automation greatly reducing costs, and everyone just earning a hard living, this problem will disappear — for example, nowadays we can make great use of tools like timed ovens, air fryers, rice cookers and pressure cookers, washing machines, robot vacuum cleaners and the like, which again allow us ordinary people, even without financial freedom, to openly declare that doing it ourselves at home is both easy and happy.

text: 以后没准全息AI普及，我70岁还能睡到电子吴彦祖（年轻版）也不是梦，但从非法到合法肯定会有一个风口期，现在这个阵痛期会让我这种性生活自由的人处境很不舒服
en: In the future, perhaps when holographic AI becomes widespread, it will not be a dream for me at seventy to still sleep with an electronic Yanzu Wu (young version), but moving from illegal to legal will surely bring a window of opportunity, and this current period of painful transition will make someone like me, who enjoys sexual freedom, feel very uncomfortable

text: 与其要我不舒服？
en: Rather than make me uncomfortable?

text: 那还不如继续性交易有风险，组织卖淫依旧可以进刑法。
en: It would be better to keep sex trading risky, and organised prostitution can still remain within the scope of the criminal law.

text: 直到科技发达组织卖淫真素人无优势的那一天。
en: until the day technology is advanced and organised prostitution truly offers no advantage to ordinary folk.

text: 毕竟死道友不死贫道嘛。
en: After all, better them than me.

text: （本答案仅针对组织卖淫合法化）
en: (This answer pertains only to the legalisation of organised prostitution.)
